name: I-360 Special Immigrant (Religious Worker, SIJ, Widow(er))
summary: Non-VAWA I-360 categories the office handles: special immigrant religious worker, special immigrant juvenile, and widow(er) of a U.S. citizen. VAWA has its own preset.

forms.title: Petition for Amerasian, Widow(er), or Special Immigrant

filing.where: See 'Where To File' on uscis.gov/i-360 (address depends on category).
filing.fee: See Form G-1055 at uscis.gov/g-1055. Some categories (for example SIJ) have no fee.

questions.label: How will you be paid or supported (salary, housing, stipend)?
Juvenile court, case number and order date
Are you in the custody of HHS (ORR)?
Date your U.S. citizen spouse died
File Form I-485 at the same time?

checklist.label: Current IRS tax-exempt determination letter (organization or group)
checklist.source: M-737 (07/15/22) Filing Checklist; I-360 Instructions 01/20/25, Religious Worker items 1-3

checklist.label: If exempt as other than a religious organization: organizing documents and literature showing religious purpose, and the Denomination Certification
Employer Attestation (Part 9 of I-360), signed by an authorized official
checklist.help: Signed by the organization, not by the client.

checklist.label: Verifiable evidence of compensation (pay records, budget, housing letter)
Proof of membership in the denomination for the 2 years before filing
Proof of continuous religious work (after age 14) for the 2 years before filing
Proof you are qualified for the position (ordination, training, certificates)
Birth certificate or other proof of age
Juvenile court order with the required findings (dependency/custody, reunification not viable, best interest)
HHS written consent (if in HHS custody and the order changed custody or placement)
Marriage certificate and proof prior marriages ended
Proof the spouse was a U.S. citizen

points: The beneficiary meets each eligibility requirement of the category, as shown by the enclosed evidence.
